title: Return-to-Brand Wear Credit on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Returns
content:
Under the Kestrel loyalty terms, a customer who returns a vehicle financed under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract receives a wear credit against the excess wear charge when a new Kestrel holding is dated close to the return:

1. A customer holding an active **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease** whose lease date falls within 60 calendar days before or after the return date receives a wear credit of **USD 400.00**.
2. A customer holding no such lease but holding an active **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** whose contract date falls within that span receives **USD 250.00**.
3. Any other customer receives no return-to-brand wear credit.

The records read are the status and lease date of the customer's leases and the status and contract date of the customer's new-vehicle retail contracts. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one; a holding dated exactly 60 days from the return date is within the span, one dated 61 days away is not.

## Input, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Wear credit |
|---|---|---|
| Active lease dated 45 days after the return | Within 60 days | 400.00 |
| Active lease dated 90 days before; active new-vehicle retail contract dated 20 days after | Lease outside, retail within | 250.00 |
| Active new-vehicle retail contract dated 61 days before; no lease | Outside | None |
| Lease that is no longer active, dated 5 days after | Not an active lease | None from the lease branch |
